thread:
elaine_pm: Heads-up — customer alpha for adaptive-routing lands next sprint. Need a finalized list of infra/runtime/security deps, gating criteria, and an owner for sequencing by EOD Thurs. who can take lead?

andrew_runtime: I can own the runtime rollout + canary plan. Will need capacity estimates from infra and a list of prompts for KV priming.

raj_infra: I can do capacity numbers. What are expected steady qps / peak qps and avg tokens per request? Also need an initial target instance type (GPU) to size.

elaine_pm: Expected steady ~12 rps, peaks ~60 rps for short bursts. Avg tokens ~150 per generation. For fallback: prefer lower-cost int8 variant. Canary keying should be by org id + route.

mike_g: For canary traffic pattern, suggest 10% -> 30% -> 60% ramp over 24h with health checks at each step. Also require KV cache priming strategy and smoke test plan.

andrew_runtime: KV priming needs ~200 seed prompts and golden outputs. @elaine_pm can you drop a sample prompt set + evals? Also will propose an autoscale policy: min pods 2, target CPU 65% / GPU util 60%.

elaine_pm: Yep — I'll export the sample prompt set and the golden eval spreadsheet by EOD today. Also note security must sign off on key rotation proof and data handling before full rollout.

lina_sec: I can own the security checklist. Quick Q: does the customer alpha include PII in prompts? if yes we need a data-flow diagram and masking plan.

elaine_pm: There are a few PII-like fields in examples but we will strip in prod; i'll add a short DFD and the masking rules to the doc bundle.

raj_infra: I'll aim to have capacity estimate + recommended instance types by Wed EOD. @andrew_runtime which quantization/profile are you planning so I can cost it out?

andrew_runtime: Plan A = int8-ptq on A10g for cost. Plan B (if latency spikes) = fp16 on A100. Also include option for dedicated cache nodes to reduce token cost.

mike_g: Can we lock a pre-prod smoke window to validate canary + failover? eng-sre needs 2h to run chaos and latency checks.

elaine_pm: Scheduling now — Friday 9–11am PT as a smoke window. I'll share calendar invite and checklist.

ops-bot: deploy-bot created task RN-1423: "Adaptive routing alpha canary plan" assigned to andrew_runtime, raj_infra, lina_sec, mike_g. Due: 2024-11-08.

mike_g: Looks good. I'll prep the healthcheck script and a quick runbook. :thumbsup:

andrew_runtime: I'll draft the canary config and share a short playbook in this thread when ready.

elaine_pm: Thanks all — goal is to have gating sign-offs + runbook by Thurs EOD so we can proceed with the alpha next week. Ping me for blockers. :raised_hands:
